title: castalia alba
intro: Castalia alba, commonly known as White Castalia, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Arum family. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia, specifically in India and China. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Castalia alba include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial effects.
